messages:
Chris: Idea: LLM Roast Night on Friday? gentle ribbing of our favorite personas. winner gets a sticker. :microphone:
Dana: i'm in. categories: 'most likely to hallucinate', 'best at passive-aggressive suggestions', 'most poetic when drunk (on tokens)'.
Omar: can we also have a 'prompt confessions' round where people read their worst prompts aloud? mine starts with 'Make this less CEO-y' and ends in chaos. :sweat_smile:
Li: vote for roast + confession. also propose a tiny trophy: a golden tiny-GPU.
emoji-bot: added reaction :trophy: to Li's message.
Chris: game rules: MAX 2 jokes per person, keep it kind, no metrics shaming (RPS <-> feelings).
Dana: PRIZE: custom sticker 'I roasted a model and all I got was this token'.
Omar: pre-emptive mitigation: we'll have an observability table next to the snacks so folks remember to check logs after a good burn.
snack-bot: Friday snack menu: 'Prompt Pretzels' + 'Transformer Truffles'. use code ROASTFRI for 5% off.
Li: also petition to add a Slack emoji :roast-model: for the event. filing in #devex.
Chris: ok RSVP: Chris, Dana, Omar, Li. I'll make a tiny leaderboard and a silly bracket.
Dana: closing note: remember to be humane to our infra. roast the persona, not the people who built it. :heart:
